description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange with effect from 29.05.2023 to 04.06.2023
categorisation: This gazette notification announces the determination of new exchange rates for customs duties and charges under the Customs Ordinance. It is a regulatory matter issued by the Director General of Customs under statutory authority, specifically addressing compliance requirements for customs payments. The content fits Legal/Regulatory classification as it involves regulatory frameworks and statutory instruments.
